headline: Calangute Shack Fire: Relief Announced
summary: A fire gutted four beach shacks in Calangute. The government announced compensation to assist affected shack owners.

headline: Four Beach Shacks Fire in Calangute
summary: Four beach shacks were completely destroyed by a fire in Goa. No injuries were reported during the incident.

headline: Shack Owners Lose Rs 1.4 Crore in Fire
summary: A fire engulfed four beach shacks in Goa, causing heavy damage. Owners suffered an estimated financial loss of Rs 1.4 crore.

headline: Cockroach Janta Party Launches Goa Campaign
summary: The Cockroach Janta Party will launch its 'Kya Bolti Public' campaign from Goa on November 22. The initiative aims to connect directly with citizens.

headline: CJP Invites Public Issues on Nov 22
summary: The Cockroach Janta Party plans to launch the 'Challa Kitem, Goa' campaign on November 22. Citizens are urged to raise local concerns during the event.

headline: CJP Schedules Public Meet in Goa
summary: The Cockroach Janta Party has fixed its 'Challa Kitem Goa' public meeting for November 22. The gathering aims to engage locals on public grievances.

headline: Goa Allows 24x7 Operations for Malls
summary: The Goa government has allowed shops and shopping malls to operate 24 hours a day across the state. The decision aims to boost local business activity.

headline: Shops in Goa Can Now Run 24/7
summary: Retail outlets and commercial malls in Goa can now remain open round-the-clock. Establishments will be able to serve customers without night closure restrictions.

headline: 24-Hour Shopping Approved in Goa
summary: Goa state authorities have permitted commercial shops and malls to function 24 hours a day. The move offers operational flexibility to local merchants.

headline: 12-Year-Old Booked for Assault in Bardez
summary: A 12-year-old boy has been booked by Goa police for allegedly sexually assaulting a four-year-old girl in Bardez. Legal action has been initiated under protection laws.

headline: Minor Boy Booked for Assault in Goa
summary: Goa police registered a case against a minor boy following an alleged sexual assault of a young girl. Authorities are investigating the complaint.

headline: POCSO Case Registered Against 11-Year-Old
summary: An 11-year-old boy has been booked under the POCSO Act for allegedly assaulting a 5-year-old girl in Goa. Police have initiated legal proceedings.

headline: Exploring the Scenic Bangalore to Goa Route
summary: A traveler detailed a road trip from Bangalore to Goa driving a BMW 3 Series. The journey highlighted a longer route that offered better driving conditions.

headline: Exhibition Showcases Goa’s Tribal Traditions
summary: A new exhibition in Goa documents the cultural traditions of three indigenous tribal communities. It displays historical practices and community lifestyle.

headline: IFFI Celebrates Global Cinema in Goa
summary: The International Film Festival of India in Goa will showcase cinema from around the globe. The event brings together international stories for film enthusiasts.

headline: Goa Home Guard Announces 176 Vacancies
summary: The Goa Home Guard department released a recruitment notification for 176 open positions. Interested candidates must submit their applications offline.

headline: New Vande Bharat Connects Bengaluru and Goa
summary: India's scenic Vande Bharat Express offers a 13-hour train journey connecting Bengaluru to Goa via Mangaluru. Ticket prices and stops have been published.

headline: 24 Goa Beaches Earmarked for Turtle Cover
summary: Authorities have earmarked 24 beaches across Goa for turtle protection and conservation. Specific measures will safeguard nesting grounds.

headline: 24-Hour Shopping Approved for Goa Outlets
summary: Shops and commercial malls across Goa can now legally remain open 24 hours a day. The policy shift aims to support round-the-clock commerce.

headline: Historic Goa Palace Faces Neglect
summary: A centuries-old palace in Goa that saw multiple rulers is facing severe physical neglect. Concerns are growing over its preservation and structural state.

headline: FDA Cracks Down on Unlicensed Chicken Supplier
summary: Food Safety officials in Goa acted against an unlicensed chicken supplier operating without proper registration. The crackdown aims to enforce food safety rules.

headline: Tiger Sighting Resurrects Reserve Demand
summary: A tiger sighting in the Mhadei basin after two years has sparked calls for a wildlife reserve. Environmentalists urge government action to protect the habitat.

headline: Kushavati District Offices Still in Margao
summary: Despite Kushavati district being notified in January, its government offices still function out of Margao. Local administration setup remains incomplete.

headline: Goa Approves Schemes to Preserve Manuscripts
summary: The Goa state cabinet approved new schemes to digitize and preserve ancient manuscripts. The effort will help safeguard historical documents.

headline: IFFI Introduces 'Films About Films' Section
summary: The International Film Festival of India introduced a new 'Films About Films' category. It highlights stories detailing filmmaking processes and directors' lives.

headline: Driver Held for Dumping Sewage Illegally
summary: Goa police seized a van and arrested its driver for illegally dumping sewage. Authorities reiterated strict warnings against unauthorized waste disposal.

headline: IFFI Opening Film to Screen Across Venues
summary: For the first time, IFFI's opening film will be screened simultaneously across multiple venues. The initiative ensures wider access for registered delegates.

headline: Monsoon Deficit Causes Crop Losses in Goa
summary: Inadequate rainfall led to crop losses estimated at Rs 18.7 lakh across Goa. Sanquelim emerged as the worst-affected agricultural region.

headline: Clean-Up Drive at Goa Heritage Sites
summary: A dedicated clean-up drive at heritage sites across Goa will start in mid-December. The effort aims to maintain cleanliness at historic locations.

headline: CJP Leaders to Host Youth Meet Nov 22
summary: Cockroach Janta Party representatives will organize a youth meet in Goa on November 22. The session will focus on addressing youth issues.

headline: Comba Well Sewage Problems Unresolved
summary: Residents in Comba continue to struggle with sewage contamination in local wells. Official site inspections have been repeatedly delayed.

headline: New Guide Highlights 507 Goa Bird Species
summary: A new QR-code guide has been published covering 507 bird species native to or visiting Goa. It serves as a resource for birdwatchers and researchers.

headline: Goa Cabinet Approves Rs 10cr for AI Policy
summary: The Goa cabinet approved five new schemes under its AI policy, sanctioning Rs 10 crore. The funds will support artificial intelligence initiatives in the state.

headline: Family Road Trip: Mumbai to Goa and Udupi
summary: A driver shared details of a 2,200 km road trip connecting Mumbai, Goa, and Udupi in a Mitsubishi Cedia. The travelogue detailed route quality and stops.

headline: IFFI Decorative Lights Threaten Heritage Trees
summary: The Green Brigade raised concerns that decorative lighting for IFFI could harm heritage trees. They urged organizers to prevent damage to tree foliage.

headline: GCCI Welcomes 24x7 Shopping Policy
summary: The Goa Chamber of Commerce and Industry welcomed the government's decision allowing round-the-clock shopping. Business leaders expect economic growth from the move.

headline: Goa Cabinet Approves Audio Visual Archive
summary: The Goa state cabinet approved a project to establish audio-visual archives documenting local oral history. The scheme aims to preserve historical narratives.

headline: Bicholim Farmers Demand Relief for Mining Damage
summary: Farmers in Bicholim requested government assistance for crop damage caused by mining activities. They asked officials to expedite inspections of damaged land.

headline: New Vande Bharat Links Bengaluru to Madgaon
summary: The Bengaluru-Mangaluru-Madgaon Vande Bharat Express provides a scenic 13-hour rail link to Goa. The service connects major coastal and inland destinations.

headline: Cuncolim Waste Clearance Facing Transport Delays
summary: Efforts to clear toxic zinc waste in Cuncolim have been delayed by transportation issues. Authorities are working to resolve logistics hurdles.

headline: Relief Announced for Calangute Fire Victims
summary: The state government announced relief support for owners of four shacks destroyed by a fire in Calangute. Authorities assessed the damage at the site.

headline: Dry Spell Damages Crops for 220 Farmers
summary: A total of 220 farmers in Goa reported significant crop damage due to an extended dry spell. Agriculture officials are reviewing the loss reports.

headline: Curpem Residents Oppose Proposed Mine
summary: Locals in Curpem expressed strong opposition to a proposed iron ore mine during a public hearing. Residents cited potential environmental and health hazards.

headline: Grease Traps Made Mandatory for Goa Eateries
summary: Goa authorities made the installation of grease traps mandatory for commercial eateries. The measure aims to stop oil and grease from choking drainage lines.

headline: Man Sentenced to 12 Years for 2018 Palolem Rape
summary: A court sentenced a Chennai man to 12 years in prison for raping a British tourist in Palolem in 2018. The ruling concludes a long legal trial.

headline: South Goa Collector Urges Quick CRZ Clearances
summary: The South Goa Collector instructed departments to fast-track pending Coastal Regulation Zone cases. The push seeks to clear administrative backlogs.

headline: Massive Fire Destroys Four Calangute Shacks
summary: A major fire swept through four shacks along Calangute beach, causing structural damage. Firefighting personnel managed to extinguish the flames.

headline: Benaulim Fishermen Await Promised Land
summary: As progress continues on a proposed police station in Benaulim, local fishermen are still waiting for allocated land. Community members requested early resolution.

headline: Teacher Arrested for Stalking Student in Bicholim
summary: Goa police arrested a school teacher in Bicholim for allegedly stalking and harassing a minor student. A case has been registered under protection laws.

headline: FRRO Cracks Down on Illegal Foreign Workers
summary: The Foreigners Regional Registration Office stepped up enforcement against illegal foreign workers in Goa. Officials are targeting visa violations across commercial sectors.
